description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an OpenShift Platform Engineer based in the United States. 

 We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Platform Engineer to help operate, automate, and continuously improve enterprise container platforms across hybrid infrastructure. In this hands-on individual-contributor role, you will support production OpenShift environments, ensuring their reliability, security, scalability, and performance. You will lead technical initiatives, automate platform operations, and troubleshoot complex infrastructure challenges in collaboration with application, security, and engineering teams. The role offers the opportunity to shape reusable engineering standards, strengthen platform resilience, and simplify application onboarding through self-service capabilities. You will work across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, storage, and cloud technologies while contributing to a secure and highly available enterprise environment.

Accountabilities
 

 
 Deploy, configure, upgrade, scale, maintain, and support production Red Hat OpenShift clusters across hybrid infrastructure.



 
 Lead assigned engineering initiatives and small to medium-complexity projects, from requirements gathering and implementation through testing, documentation, and production support.



 
 Automate cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, and recurring operational tasks using scripting, infrastructure as code, configuration management, GitOps, and CI/CD practices.



 
 Troubleshoot complex issues across Kubernetes, Linux, containers, networking, ingress, DNS, certificates, storage, compute, identity, and application connectivity.



 
 Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, support, and vendor teams to resolve platform issues and improve service delivery.



 
 Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, health checks, dashboards, and platform metrics to strengthen reliability, performance, and capacity planning.



 
 Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis, define corrective actions, and help prevent recurring issues.



 
 Support backup, recovery, high availability, resiliency, and disaster-recovery capabilities, including validation and recovery exercises.



 
 Maintain platform security controls, including RBAC, workload policies, secrets, certificates, and vulnerability remediation, in partnership with cybersecurity and risk teams.



 
 Develop secure, reusable application-onboarding configurations and self-service patterns that make platform adoption easier.



 
 Gather and validate technical requirements, review designs, identify implementation risks, and recommend appropriate solutions.



 
 Create and maintain platform standards, implementation plans, operational procedures, and support documentation.



 
 Participate in peer reviews of automation and production changes, share technical knowledge, and follow engineering, change-management, IT service-management, security, and regulatory practices.



 
 Contribute to an on-call support rotation.




 Requirements:


 
 At least 6 years of combined higher education and/or professional experience in systems design, management, and/or architecture.



 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience administering and supporting production OpenShift or Kubernetes environments.



 
 Strong troubleshooting skills across container platforms and supporting technologies, including Linux, networking, storage, compute, identity, and application connectivity.



 
 Experience automating infrastructure or platform operations through scripting, configuration management, infrastructure as code, GitOps, or CI/CD.



 
 Familiarity with Git-based development workflows, peer reviews, testing, and controlled change-management practices.



 
 Ability to independently deliver engineering assignments with limited supervision and lead technical work through implementation and production support.



 
 Strong analytical skills, including the ability to gather technical requirements, assess implementation risks, and recommend solutions based on technical evidence.



 
 Working knowledge of enterprise resiliency, high availability, observability, backup, and recovery practices.



 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across application and infrastructure teams.




 Preferred qualifications:


 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.



 
 Experience administering Red Hat OpenShift in a production, multi-cluster environment.



 
 Exposure to Azure Red Hat OpenShift, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon EKS, or Red Hat OpenShift on AWS.



 
 Linux systems-administration experience and familiarity with Podman or Docker.



 
 Experience with GitOps and continuous delivery tools such as Argo CD or comparable platforms.



 
 Automation skills using Ansible, Terraform, Python, Go, or Bash.



 
 Knowledge of observability practices, including metrics, logs, dashboards, alerting, and capacity analysis.



 
 Familiarity with container security, vulnerability remediation, image governance, secrets management, certificates, and policy enforcement.



 
 Experience supporting application onboarding to OpenShift or Kubernetes.



 
 Background in financial services or another highly regulated industry.




 Benefits:


 
 Annual salary range: $97,100–$161,800 USD, with individual compensation determined by relevant knowledge, skills, experience, and location.



 
 Competitive, market-informed compensation.



 
 Medical benefits and retirement offerings.



 
 40 hours of paid volunteer time annually.



 
 Remote-eligible work arrangement within the United States.



 
 Opportunities to develop technical expertise, collaborate with experienced engineers, and contribute to enterprise-scale platform improvements.
